title: manilkara triflora
intro: Manilkara triflora, commonly known as the "Malabar plum" or "wild mangosteen", is a tropical plant species that belongs to the Sapotaceae family. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include the ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and aid in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Manilkara triflora include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to protect against oxidative stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
